description:
The MCP server emits non-protocol output to stdout during result export,
which breaks stdio MCP clients like the codex CLI. For stdio MCP servers,
stdout must contain exclusively JSON-RPC messages. When ResultExporter
prints status lines to stdout, it corrupts the JSON-RPC stream, causing
strict clients to close the transport with "Transport closed" errors.

Root cause: ResultExporter in benchbox/core/results/exporter.py uses
self.console.print() at multiple points (lines 167, 171, 175, 247, 255)
to output status messages. When MCP tools create ResultExporter without
a quiet console, these messages leak to stdout.

The fix uses the existing quiet-mode infrastructure in benchbox/utils/printing.py
which already provides get_quiet_console() and set_quiet() utilities.
